description: Office of the Chief Secretary, Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Convene the meeting for the Electing a New Chairman for the Vacant Chairman Post of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the convening of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha specifically for the purpose of electing a new Chairman, which falls under electoral processes at the local government level. The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it clearly related to election procedures and scheduling rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
